scenario: [LECC.6.4]: `adapter` is a family [LECC.2.2] names, so `error adapter:` (the family) and `error adapter.throttled:` (a leaf under it) on one call both compile. The control for compiler/LECC.6.4_unknown_family_refused: a check that refused every pattern would fail here. PATH PINNED: dsc.validate `lecc_6_4_error_family`, which admits the first segment `adapter`.
rules_ds:
service svc.connect:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.connect entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 30_s
        error adapter:
            log info "adapter error"
        error adapter.throttled:
            log info "throttled"
